annotations.title: Change a reservation's dates or room type

description: Changes: moves one stay's dates or room type: nights kept keep their price, nights added at that night's price; posted nights are never re-priced. Previews first: the first call shows the change and makes nothing. Changes a stay's check-in, check-out or room type. First call without confirm: a preview (the nights, the new total), nothing changes; then call again with the same values, confirm true and preview_id. When a night needs a plan pick the preview names the nights and plans: send night_plans. Not for a stay booked on Expedia or Booking.com: change it there. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to go ahead with the change shown in the preview

night_plans.description: Night YYYY-MM-DD → plan code, only when the preview asked for a pick
